about_the_game:
Gameplay:

Goal

get to the top of the pinball machine.

Controls

Left button for the left flipper, right for the right. Pull the plunger (that metal thing that launches the ball from the start). That’s it.

Expecting more from a pinball machine?

Easy to learn, hard to master

Maintain the ball’s momentum and time your flipper hits just right. Use the environment to your advantage and discover your own shortcuts.

(Warning: Sometimes a clever idea can backfire.)

Varied levels, each with its own personality.

Every new stage brings fresh challenges—ride the wind, hit buttons, travel through gravity tunnels, smash meteors, and conquer arenas!

A true paradise for speedrunners!

(Before making any rash decisions, remember: the beginning is always a place you can return to.)

Immersive visual style:

The machine clearly shows its age-chipped paint reveals once-hidden screws, and loose wires occasionally peek through.

Still, none of that takes away from the handcrafted charm and craftsmanship FlippTech once poured into their machines.

(FlippTech is not responsible for any damage to your mental well-being, nor for any destruction caused while attempting to complete this product. Play responsibly.)
